scope: Proposition 4.4 (Change of a weighted number observable) of the manuscript “Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap” (preprints/Uniform-Stability-of-the-Spherical-Laughlin-Gap-October-5-2026/uniform-stability-spherical-laughlin-gap.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 269 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1bb20744f2bfa51), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The operator Kq,d(f) = Uq,d(1)∗ Dt(f)Uq,d(1) − Dt(f) has a rapid interaction representation of size CAq(m). Its interaction difference under a bounded change in q, with d fixed, has size CAq(m)/v in common frames. The pieces may be assigned to their original annular centers throughout the construction.
